You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 4f22aa4569e55131d69dae87e76869070d62c392 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2021 17:42:02 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] qcom: spm: allow compile-testing

ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE can be selected when compile-testing on
other architectures, but this causes a Kconfig warning
for QCOM_SPM:

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for QCOM_SPM
  Depends on [n]: ARCH_QCOM [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE [=y] && CPU_IDLE [=y] && (ARM [=y] || ARM64) && (ARCH_QCOM [=n] || COMPILE_TEST [=y]) && !ARM64 && MMU [=y]

Make it possible to also compile-test this one, which can
be done now that v5.15-rc5 lets you select QCOM_SCM everywhere.

Fixes: a871be6b8eee ("cpuidle: Convert Qualcomm SPM driver to a generic CPUidle driver")
Fixes: 498ba2a8a275 ("cpuidle: Fix ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE configuration")
Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
---
 drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig b/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
index 3cf3a6b41182..e718b8735444 100644
--- a/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig
@@ -192,7 +192,7 @@ config QCOM_SOCINFO
 
 config QCOM_SPM
 	tristate "Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager (SPM)"
-	depends on ARCH_QCOM
+	depends on ARCH_QCOM || COMPILE_TEST
 	select QCOM_SCM
 	help
 	  Enable the support for the Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager, used
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the Kconfig configuration for the Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager (SPM) driver, which incorrectly enforced a dependency on the ARCH_QCOM architecture. This restriction led to a Kconfig warning when attempting to compile-test the driver on other architectures, as it resulted in unmet direct dependencies when ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE was selected. The patch modifies the dependency to allow compile-testing by adding the COMPILE_TEST option, thus resolving the warning and enabling broader testing capabilities.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the Kconfig configuration for the Qualcomm Subsystem Power Manager (SPM) driver, which incorrectly enforced a dependency on the ARCH_QCOM architecture. This restriction led to a Kconfig warning when attempting to compile-test the driver on other architectures, as it resulted in unmet direct dependencies when ARM_QCOM_SPM_CPUIDLE was selected. The patch modifies the dependency to allow compile-testing by adding the COMPILE_TEST option, thus resolving the warning and enabling broader testing capabilities.
